recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of a male vocalist in a white ruffled shirt and high-waisted black trousers, centered against a vibrant orange background with a circular yellow-orange glow. The layout features bold, condensed slab-serif typography at the top and a right-aligned tracklist in sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a radial light burst
Large-scale display type spanning the upper third
Right-justified text block balancing the subject's open-arm pose
High-contrast monochromatic clothing against a saturated warm background
coreInvariants: Radial yellow glow behind the subject
Full-body standing pose with arms extended

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 60% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's white shirt, which provides the highest value contrast against the orange background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large name at the top, moves down to the subject's face, follows the right arm to the tracklist, and ends at the technical metadata at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample orange space surrounding the subject to emphasize the 'spotlight' effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Crisp white for the shirt and primary display text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep black for trousers and secondary text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high value contrast between the subject's clothing and the field.

letterConstructionRules: Display type uses heavy, rectangular slabs
Tight tracking on the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold slab-serif for impact paired with a clean sans-serif for legibility in lists.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangle frame for technical text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif aesthetic of the 1960s.
Appropriate for the secondary sans-serif text blocks.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body studio photograph of a 1960s male soul singer in a white ruffled shirt and black high-waisted trousers, arms spread wide in a performance gesture. The background is a vibrant solid orange with a soft, circular yellow-orange glow directly behind the singer's torso.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, white condensed slab-serif text across the top. Place a right-aligned list of song titles in black sans-serif on the right side of the image. Add a horizontal black line at the very bottom with technical text in a small rounded box on the left.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated orange?
Is the main title in a white slab-serif font?
Is the singer's shirt white and ruffed?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
Record label logo in the top right
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's face
Verify the orange is vibrant and not muddy
Check that the slab-serif is sufficiently bold
Confirm the radial glow is centered on the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + Radial glow background + Bold slab-serif header + Right-aligned sans-serif list = Mid-century vocal album aesthetic.
